newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Winbond in T$1.4 bln suit for fire loss.
newsitem.headline: Winbond in T$1.4 bln suit for fire loss.

text.p: Winbond Electronics Corp, one of Taiwan's leading semiconductor makers, said on Wednesday it had filed civil litigation against five insurance firms, requesting T$1.4 billion for a fire loss which occurred in October 1996.
Winbond said in a statement that the request of T$1.4 billion was the first round out of the total loss claim of T$3.7 billion that should be covered in its insurance.
The five co-insurance firms are Tai Ping Insurance, Fubon Insurance, Central Insurance, Mingtai Fire and Marine Insurance and Shin Kong Insurance, it said.
Winbond said it filed the suit after a seven-month unsatisfactory negotiation with the insurers regarding the insurance claims on the fire accident at its third wafer fabrication plant.

Fire swept through its unfinished third wafer fabrication plant last October. There were no casualties. Winbond said then its plans to start production at the plant in the first quarter of 1997 were unaffected.
